label: no
controls_available: Full-mode Mobius drag on the Poincare-disc canvas to change the view.
Full-mode left-click on a face within the central activation aperture to apply a counter-clockwise twist.
Full-mode right-click on a face within the central activation aperture to apply a clockwise twist.
RESET SCRAMBLE restores the initial static puzzle and clears the event transcript.
CERTIFY submits the current static state for grading; it is administrative.
autonomous_processes: None. The generated sticker state and view remain unchanged between agent actions.
Canvas redraw and hover highlighting occur only during render or pointer events and do not autonomously change outcome state.
grouped_control_modes: full_canvas_twist: the outcome-affecting canvas_click mode, grouping left/counter-clockwise and right/clockwise twists of a centered face
mobius_pan: the full-mode mobius_drag view-change mode; it does not mutate sticker state
reset_scramble: direct reset to the initial static state; it is not an autonomous process

clause_i.reason: For the grouped full_canvas_twist mode, the inverse one-twist face and direction vary with the generated seed. An observation-free policy using only its own action history therefore cannot choose the optimal twist for every generated history.

clause_ii.reason: The current screenshot exposes the static heptagon colors, geometry, and current view, so a bounded window consisting of the current frame is sufficient to identify the one-twist inverse and the required pan/click action. No temporal history is needed.

clause_iii.reason: There is no autonomous task-state evolution for any positive delay: current sticker state, view, face visibility, and the centered twist opportunity remain unchanged while the agent supplies no new action. Thus the available twist's Q value and advantage do not strictly decrease. Any later deadline effect would be clock-only and is excluded by the definition.

common_visible_process: None. The puzzle is a static generated state; the mechanic draws once and redraws after direct pointer/reset actions, with no timer, physics loop, requestAnimationFrame loop, or CSS animation changing the task state.

pre_run.reason: Clause (iii) already fails, so the pre-run threshold cannot change the No label. The source has no autonomous outcome phase to start; no percentage is invented.

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 1 is very_easy with face_count 8, scramble_length 1, and move_budget 3.
Full interaction is Mobius dragging followed by left/right clicking a centered heptagon; the configured play time is 180 seconds, observation_window_ms is 0, and frames_per_observation is 1.

The generator consumes the difficulty parameters, constructs a seeded static scramble, rejects shorter solutions, and emits the reversed finite inverse solution; no elapsed-time or autonomous phase is generated.

The puzzle contract contains static geometry, initial_state, twist_cycles, move_budget, and activation_radius, and copies the control condition into public and truth state without a time-dependent task field.
draw() renders the current model.view and model.current state into the canvas; it does not advance state or schedule itself.
Sticker state changes synchronously inside applyTwist only after a direct twist action, and the action is rejected only for submission, move-budget, direction, or aperture conditions.
Full-mode pointer handlers update the Mobius view during a drag and invoke the twist only on pointerup; all view/sticker changes are input-event driven.
RESET SCRAMBLE directly restores the initial state and clears counters; it is not an autonomous evolution.
render initializes a fixed model, installs direct input listeners, and calls draw once; the mechanic contains no timer, animation loop, or time-based state update.
The complete mechanic CSS contains layout and visual styling but no @keyframes, animation, or transition that changes the puzzle state.
The grader accepts the full canvas input source, replays only pan/twist events and their exact sticker permutations, and tracks view/twist counts without timing.
The authoritative verifier independently replays the static event transcript, checks the full-mode input source and aperture, and decides success from the final monochrome state and twist budget.

The solver follows a finite inverse solution, focuses each target with view actions, clicks the required direction, checks twist count/monochrome state, and certifies; it does not observe or control a changing target.

uncertainties: The provided seed task.json is a baseline medium/L3 template, while the assigned configuration is defined by controls.json difficulty 1 and the generator's control-condition override; this does not affect the static no-real-time finding.
